items.html: Now, concerning the Akudim, the matter of the discernment of Taamim, Nekudot, tagin, and letters in them has already been explained above; and here we shall explain them in the discernment of the Nekudim. And we shall say that the discernment of the Nekudim are the first lights that came out at first, and the letters are the vessels. And afterwards, when the vessels were broken and they were separated one from the presence of the other and died, (48) the lights remained in the discernment of tagin upon the letters, which are the vessels. And the Taamim are the new name MA, which came out afterwards from the light of the Metzach [forehead] for the correction of the kings, as will be written with God’s help.
